# watchpoint_log_pipeline (Resource)

The tenant's log pipeline: ordered processors applied to every log at ingest, then the tenant's PII redaction rules. A per-tenant singleton: declare it at most once. Other pods pick up a change within 60 seconds. Processors require the `log_pipelines` feature (SMB); PII rules work on every plan. Destroying the resource clears both lists, which restores the platform's default redaction.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Parse checkout's access lines, drop debug noise, and mask an internal
# account-number format. Declare this resource once per tenant.
resource "watchpoint_log_pipeline" "this" {
  processors_json = jsonencode([
    {
      type    = "grok"
      name    = "access line"
      enabled = true
      filter  = "service:checkout"
      source  = "body"
      pattern = "%%{IP:client.ip} %%{WORD:http.method} %%{URIPATH:url.path} %%{NUMBER:http.status_code}"
    },
    {
      type    = "drop"
      name    = "debug noise"
      enabled = true
      filter  = "severity:debug"
    },
  ])

  pii_rules_json = jsonencode([
    {
      name            = "account_number"
      pattern         = "ACCT-[0-9]{8}"
      replacement     = "ACCT-[REDACTED]"
      appliesToFields = "body"
      isActive        = true
    },
  ])
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `pii_rules_json` (String) JSON array of PII rules (25 max), each `{name, pattern, replacement, appliesToFields, isActive}`. A rule named `email`, `card` or `ip` replaces that built-in and an inactive one switches it off; others are added after the built-ins. JWT, SSN, bearer and authorization redaction always run and cannot be overridden.
- `processors_json` (String) JSON array of processors, run in order (50 max). Each has a `type` (`grok`, `regex`, `json`, `set`, `rename`, `remove`, `severity`, `drop`, `route`) plus `name`, `enabled`, an optional `filter` (for example `service:checkout -severity:debug`) and the fields its type needs, such as `source`, `pattern` or `key`. Use camelCase keys, as `jsonencode` of an HCL object does. Compared as JSON; defaults the API fills in are not drift.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Tenant ID, which this setting is keyed on.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import watchpoint_log_pipeline.this <tenant_id>
```
